scope: NEW surfaces only. The ~48 surfaces already enumerated in data/distribution.json were not re-walked.

vscode_gallery_experiment.hypothesis: entries whose registry record points at a monorepo subfolder are excluded from the VS Code MCP gallery
vscode_gallery_experiment.why_r1_measured_zero: api.mcp.github.com/v0/servers is deprecated and flattens repository into a legacy shape with no subfolder field, for every row. The 0 of 252 was the v0 schema, not the gallery.
vscode_gallery_experiment.closest_analogue_to_ours: com.soracom/knowledge, 4 stars, subfolder servers/knowledge, in the gallery

base_rates_registry_wide.reading: A subfolder is slightly MORE common inside the gallery than outside it.

instrument_repair.broken_endpoint: https://api.mcp.github.com/v0/servers (deprecation: true, cursor is the last row id and is then rejected 400)
instrument_repair.script: scripts/vscode-gallery-watch.mjs rewritten; runs the probe with microsoft/markitdown as a fail-closed positive control

vscode_gallery_experiment.real_separator: Not a readable field. 252 rows against a registry of at least 20,000 is a 1.3% hand-curated slice; stars, organisation, namespace, namespace-owner match, package type, remotes, server.json at root, publication month and one-entry-per-repo were all falsified.
vscode_gallery_experiment.submission_route: An onboarding-request comment on github/github-mcp-server discussion #1257, confirmed by GitHub staff as the manual curation queue. Free, no account beyond an existing GitHub login.
vscode_gallery_experiment.route_measured_yield: 2 of 11 requesters are in the gallery; the 2026-07..09 cohort is 0 of 8
vscode_gallery_experiment.migration_plan: DO NOT MIGRATE. R1's contingency (repoint 89 registry entries at the 32 one-server mirrors) was justified only by the subfolder hypothesis. With the hypothesis refuted it buys nothing and would still put a single squashed force-pushed commit in front of every server, which is exactly what earns Glama's Maintenance C. Decide the mirror commit-history question on Glama's merits alone.

github-mcp-registry-onboarding.submit_route: Post an 'Onboarding request' comment with a metadata table on discussion #1257. Public Q&A discussion, closed and answered but not locked.
github-mcp-registry-onboarding.evidence: GitHub staff @hstaudacher 2025-11-10 'the GitHub MCP registry is a curated list'; @trent-j 2026-05-19 'onboarding a new server is still a manual curation process today'
github-mcp-registry-onboarding.measured_yield: 2 of 11 servers requested in the thread are in the gallery today (membership probe); both belong to the one publisher a GitHub engineer engaged with directly. The 2026-07..09 cohort is 0 of 8.
github-mcp-registry-onboarding.note: This is the route R1 recorded as non-existent. It reaches the VS Code picker. Do not re-post; watch the thread.

sagargupta16-awesome-mcp-servers.submit_route: PR adding one table row to README.md in an existing category, alphabetical; fill the PR template including the affiliation box; one server per PR
sagargupta16-awesome-mcp-servers.rules: Description 80 chars max, capital first letter, no trailing period, no em/en dash; self-promotion allowed if disclosed; python scripts/validate.py must pass
sagargupta16-awesome-mcp-servers.note: validate.py reports 2 problems that already exist on main and none about this entry; that is stated in the PR body rather than hidden behind a ticked box

blockrunai-awesome-finance-mcp.submit_route: PR adding one table row to README.md, Community Contributions -> Personal Finance
blockrunai-awesome-finance-mcp.rules: Description under 60 chars; pricing from a fixed vocabulary; PR title 'Add [MCP Name]'; no promotional language; must be finance-related
blockrunai-awesome-finance-mcp.note: Five outside-contributor merges on 2026-09-05 alone. Only the ~10 finance-shaped servers qualify here.

kilo-code-marketplace.submit_route: PR adding mcps/<id>/MCP.yaml; the index is regenerated by .github/workflows/generate-marketplace.yml
kilo-code-marketplace.entry: zovo-back-office, one entry with six selectable streamable-http toolsets
kilo-code-marketplace.rules: category must be one of business|data|development|observability|productivity|search|web-automation; id matches the directory; each content variant is a JSON client config; headers supported
kilo-code-marketplace.note: This is the in-IDE Marketplace tab of the Kilo Code editor, not a web directory. 126 MCP entries today, so a fleet drop would be spam; one multi-toolset entry follows the mcps/agent-platform-mcp precedent.

wundercorp-awesome-mcp.submit_route: PR adding servers/<category>/<slug>/server.json, then run node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs and node scripts/generate-readme.mjs and commit the regenerated README
wundercorp-awesome-mcp.rules: One server per PR; schema requires slug,name,category,description,homepage_url,license,status; folder must match category and slug
wundercorp-awesome-mcp.checks_run: validate-catalog.mjs -> Validated 23 MCP server entries; generate-readme.mjs -> Generated README.md with 9 populated categories

chat2anyllm-awesome-mcp-servers.submit_route: PR adding servers/<slug>.yaml, run make ci, commit dist/
chat2anyllm-awesome-mcp-servers.note: Four outside merges on 2026-09-03. Not submitted this round only for time; the build step is the only friction. Category 'productivity' fits most servers.

punkpeye-awesome-remote-mcp-servers.status: skipped: per-entry emoji and a required star
punkpeye-awesome-remote-mcp-servers.submit_route: PR editing README.md, three lines per entry, alphabetical within category
blocking_rules: Every entry must carry an authentication marker emoji (open lock / key / closed lock) and agent PRs opt in by putting three robot emoji in the PR title
'Star the repository. This is required -- PRs are not merged unless the account opening them has starred the repo.'
A Glama connector badge is mandatory and CI verifies it resolves
punkpeye-awesome-remote-mcp-servers.note: Best topical fit found anywhere: remote-only list, merging several outside PRs per day, and this project has 30 hosted endpoints. Skipped to stay consistent with the operator's no-emoji rule, which already cost yzfly/Awesome-MCP-ZH, AlexMili/Awesome-MCP and tolkonepiu/best-of-mcp-servers. Reversible in one PR if the operator waives it; the star is a separate account action and is also the operator's call.

mcpfind.status: blocked: needs a published npm/PyPI/Docker package
mcpfind.submit_route: PR appending to community-servers.yml, PR title exactly 'Add: <server-name>'
mcpfind.note: CONTRIBUTING requires 'published to npm, PyPI, or available as a Docker image'. mcpb bundles on GitHub releases do not satisfy it, and npm publishing is human-gated (see distribution.json npm). Unblocks the day npm login happens. No verified outside-contributor merge found either.

jaw9c-awesome-remote-mcp-servers.note: Highest star count of any remote-server list, and the scope is an exact fit, but 755 open PRs and no maintainer activity for ~80 days. A cheap lottery ticket, not a plan.

toolhive-catalog.status: new: gated by a repo hygiene rule
toolhive-catalog.submit_route: PR adding a server record in the official server.schema.json shape with remotes[]; automated verification then maintainer review
toolhive-catalog.note: docs/server-criteria.md requires pinned dependencies AND GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs. Check our workflows before spending a PR. This is where stacklok/toolhive's registry moved.

chatbox-registry.submit_route: PR editing src/renderer/components/settings/mcp/registries.ts, MCP_ENTRIES_COMMUNITY array, alphabetical by name; stdio only, so a remote endpoint must be wrapped in npx -y mcp-remote <url>
chatbox-registry.note: The PR template requires ticking a contributor agreement that grants the proprietary edition free commercial rights. That is a licensing decision for the operator, not an agent. Largest installed base of any client catalogue found.

zencoder-zenagents-library.submit_route: PR editing mcp-library.json (99 servers); mirrored at zencoder.ai/marketplace/mcp/<id>
zencoder-zenagents-library.note: A workflow copies mcp-library.json to a public GCS bucket on push to main, so the file is the live product. Submission guidelines in the README cover agents/*.json rather than MCP, so the precedent is unwritten and the maintainers reserve rejection at their sole discretion. Every entry carries a base64 64x64 PNG icon.

flowise-mcp-nodes.status: new: code contribution not a listing
flowise-mcp-nodes.submit_route: PR adding packages/components/nodes/tools/MCP/<Name>/<Name>MCP.ts plus an icon, or a marketplace template under packages/server/marketplaces
flowise-mcp-nodes.note: The artefact is a TypeScript node implementing INode with category 'Tools (MCP)', not a catalogue row, so it carries maintenance cost. No existing marketplace template references MCP, which makes that slot uncontested.

mcpsvr-5ire.submit_route: PR editing public/servers.json (60 entries); powers the 5ire client's in-app market
mcpsvr-5ire.note: Every entry is a command plus args. Our stdio artefact is an mcpb bundle, which is not an npx target, and the mcp-remote wrapper cannot carry a per-user token cleanly. Also 6 PRs have sat open since 2026-06-18. Unblocks with npm.

gemini-cli-extensions.status: new: ready, needs a commit we do not own
gemini-cli-extensions.submit_route: No submission at all. A public GitHub repo with the topic gemini-cli-extension and a gemini-extension.json at the repo ROOT is crawled daily.
gemini-cli-extensions.evidence: docs/extensions/releasing.md in google-gemini/gemini-cli: 'You don't need to submit an issue or email us.' 664 repos already carry the topic (gh api search/repositories?q=topic:gemini-cli-extension).
gemini-cli-extensions.note: Cheapest unlock found. Two steps: gh repo edit --add-topic gemini-cli-extension, and commit gemini-extension.json to the repo root with an mcpServers map (httpUrl is supported). Blocked here only because committing to servers/ and repo roots is outside this round's file ownership, and the mirrors are force-pushed by sync-mirrors.sh so a manual commit there would be wiped. Hand to the orchestrator.

claude-code-plugin-marketplaces.submit_route: PR adding a plugin with an .mcp.json to a community marketplace repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; wshobson/agents requires make validate and make garden
claude-code-plugin-marketplaces.note: anthropics/claude-code's own marketplace.json holds only first-party ./plugins/*, so there is no official route. composio-community/awesome-claude-plugins is a second target.

tuanone123-awesome-mcp-registries.note: Useful as an input to future rounds rather than a place to list a server.

an Actor built and published from the console

n8n-creator-hub.note: From 2026-05-01 npm provenance via GitHub Actions is mandatory, and the verification rule is one third-party service per package. A 32-server fleet is disqualified unless split into 32 packages. npm is already human-gated for this project.

refact-mcp-marketplace.evidence: gh api repos/smallcloudai/refact -> archived true, pushed 2026-05-30; gh pr create -> 'Repository was archived so is read-only'
refact-mcp-marketplace.note: Its refact-agent/engine/src/yaml_configs/mcp_marketplace_index.json holds 161 servers and is stale since 2026-04-26. Worth recording for a second reason: its fetch_official_registry_servers calls the official registry with ?limit=<=100, drops the search query and never follows nextCursor, so a client that claims to pass through the official registry surfaces only its first page. Do not assume 'registry-backed' means 'we are in it'.
